candidate_evidence.quote: This gene carries instructions that cause the tumor cells to turn Toca FC, typically used to treat fungal infections, into a drug that may kill the tumor cells.

candidate_flag.reason: Extended-release flucytosine (Toca FC) is a drug but is the prodrug partner of the Toca 511 gene therapy; if judged inseparable from the gene therapy there is no pharmacological candidate.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The microenvironmental and tumor signatures are derived from ribonucleic acid (RNA) sequencing.

coder_notes: Conditions list anaplastic astrocytoma and oligodendroglioma but eligibility is presumptive GBM; patients with other final histology are treated but not analysed in the primary endpoint; coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Toca 511 is a gene therapy (excluded type); Toca FC (extended-release flucytosine) coded as the candidate by analogy with a drug paired with an excluded vaccine, but flagged. TME RNA signature is a predictive-benefit correlative, not target engagement. Optune device at physician discretion in Arm I not listed (device).
